sections.name: Product search
sections.summary: The storefront search box and search results page let shoppers find products by keywords. Results list matching items; empty queries or nonsense queries yield an empty results state. Advanced Search offers extra filters beyond the header search field.
example_intents: I have jaw bruxism problem, show me something that could alleviate the problem.
What is the price range of wireless earphone in the One Stop Market?
What is the price range of teeth grinding mouth guard in the One Stop Market?
What is the price range of Canon photo printer in the One Stop Market?
I have a lot of Nintendo Switch game cards now, help me find the best storage option to fit all 11 cards
I have a lot of Nintendo Switch game cards now, help me find the best storage option to fit all 31 cards
I have a lot of Nintendo Switch game cards now, help me find the best storage option to fit all 6 cards
I have a lot of Nintendo Switch game cards now, help me find the best storage option to fit all 23 cards

sections.name: Categories and catalog
sections.summary: Category pages (e.g. Electronics) list products in a department. Shoppers open a top-level category, then often a subcategory, then a product from the listing.
example_intents: I want to browse the products in the Video Game category
I want to browse the products in the Headphones category
I want to browse the products in the Men shoes category
I want to browse the products in the Woman clothing category
I want to browse the products in the Cabinets, Racks & Shelves category
List products from PS4 accessories category by ascending price
List products from nutrition bars and drinks category by ascending price
List products from competitive swimwear category by ascending price

sections.name: Product detail page
sections.summary: A product page shows title, price, description, images, and actions such as Add to Cart. It is reached from search results or category listings.
example_intents: Add this product to my wishlist
List out reviewers, if exist, who mention about ear cups being small
List out reviewers, if exist, who mention about under water photo
List out reviewers, if exist, who mention about good fingerprint resistant
List out reviewers, if exist, who mention about price being unfair
List out reviewers, if exist, who mention about average print quality
Add Tide PODS Spring Meadow Scent HE Turbo Laundry Detergent Pacs, 81 Count to my wish list
Add 2 Hawaiian Bamboo Orchid Roots #zc50 - by Discount Hawaiian Gifts to my wish list

sections.name: Shopping cart
sections.summary: The shopping cart holds items the shopper plans to buy. Magento also shows a mini-cart (My Cart) in the header; View and Edit Cart opens the full cart page at /checkout/cart/ where quantities can be updated before checkout.
example_intents: Add the product with the lowest per unit price from my open tabs to the shopping cart
Add a chair to my wish list.
Add a white desk to my wish list.
Add a white computer desk to my wish list.

sections.name: Checkout
sections.summary: Checkout collects shipping address, shipping method, and payment to place an order. Guests can usually check out without an account. The flow starts from the cart via Proceed to Checkout and lands on /checkout/.
example_intents: What is the date when I made my first purchase on this site?
Show me the shipping method for order number 187.
Rate my recent purchase of floor lamp with 5 stars, using my nickname Emma Lopez?
Rate my recent purchase of Jiffy Corn Muffin Cornbread Mix with 4 stars, using my nickname ShoppingEmma?

Rate my recent purchase of Foundation For Mattress With Frame Set with 1 stars, using my nickname ShoppingEmma?
Rate my recent purchase of Mini Wireless Bluetooth Speaker with 2 stars, using my nickname SimpleEmma?
Draft an email to the shop owner via their contact us function for a coupon as I plan to make a bulk purchase

sections.name: Customer account
sections.summary: Registered customers sign in to My Account to manage profile information, addresses, and related account pages. Login is at /customer/account/login/; after success the account dashboard is at /customer/account/.
example_intents: I recently moved, my address is 231 Willow Way, Suite 100, Chicago, IL, 60601, update my information on OneStopShopping accordingly

sections.name: Orders and returns
sections.summary: Logged-in customers open order history (My Orders) from the account area. Guests can use Orders and Returns in the footer (/sales/guest/form/) to look up an order without signing in.
example_intents: Today is 6/12/2023. Tell me how many fulfilled orders I have over the past month, and the total amount of money I spent.
Today is 6/12/2023. Tell me how many fulfilled orders I have over the past three days, and the total amount of money I spent.

sections.summary: Contact Us is a storefront form (often linked from the footer) for sending a message to the merchant without completing a purchase.
